units.source_text: 上边那株和下边这株相距约莫一尺。

en.t: The plant above and the one below were about one foot apart.

units.source_text: 妙龄的千重子不免想道：“上边和下边的紫花地丁彼此会不会相见，会不会相识呢？”

en.t: Chieko, in the bloom of youth, could not help wondering, "Will the violets above and below ever meet each other, ever come to know each other?"

units.source_text: 她所想的紫花地丁“相见”和“相识”是什么意思呢？

en.t: What did she mean by the violets "meeting" and "knowing each other"?
